kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: U.S. and Iran miss peace talks deadline. And, Alaska, Florida and Wyoming primaries
wire.summary: The U.S. and Iran missed a deadline to begin peace talks this week. The monthslong war has depleted U.S. resources. And, what to know about Alaska's U.S. Senate seat primary.

wire.title: The grueling fight over who profits from AI music
wire.summary: AI can generate songs in seconds. But behind every AI track is a complicated question: Who should get paid? And, how? The fights have started.

wire.title: In Portland, this soap box derby combines downhill speed with extreme pageantry
wire.summary: Soap box derbies send motorless cars down a steep incline. At one event, contestants make their cars look like cartoon characters, subway cars, food, and giant animals (among other outlandish shapes).

wire.title: Many recent grads say AI is making it harder to get a job. Economists aren't so sure
wire.summary: The unemployment rate for young adults with new degrees is higher than the rate for all workers, according to the New York Fed. Is AI the problem, or is it more complicated?

wire.title: This crowded Republican primary in Florida has drawn a unique cast of candidates
wire.summary: The GOP primary in Florida's 19th District includes candidates who are new to the state, candidates who've run for Congress before and two candidates who have received pardons from President Trump.

wire.title: She told no one about her agony except ChatGPT. What her death reveals about AI risks
wire.summary: A 29-year-old woman confided her suicidal thoughts to an AI chatbot — not to her therapist, not to her parents, not to her best friend. What can AI learn from her death?

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Jared Kushner and Israel's prime minister meet in attempt to move Gaza ceasefire plan forward, U.S. focus on Iran draws key resources from Asia, voters head to the polls for primaries Tuesday.

wire.title: A dispute about fact vs. fiction at the trial over Tupac Shakur's 1996 killing
wire.summary: A prosecutor said that while few have been willing to speak about the 1996 killing of Tupac Shakur, Duane "Keffe D" Davis is the "one person who has a hard time being silent."

wire.title: Palestinian American returns to his West Bank home, under siege by Israeli settlers
wire.summary: The Palestinian American whose home in the occupied West Bank has been besieged by Israeli settlers traveled to his property on Monday to join other family members who have been defending it.

wire.title: Part of a key firearms law lapsed following a federal court decision. What happens now?
wire.summary: A federal judge's decision in Texas has major implications for the National Firearms Act. What does this mean for certain guns and other weapons?

wire.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
wire.summary: Russia accuses the UK of escalating the Ukraine war by supplying British-made drones as the prime minister vows to support Kyiv in its "hour of need".

wire.title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
wire.summary: Multiple children are feared to have been conceived using sperm and egg donors which were not the ones selected by the parents.

wire.title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
wire.summary: After he was shot multiple times, Tupac Shakur refused to cooperate with police and told an officer "we'll take care of it", an officer testified.

wire.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
wire.summary: German authorities seize dinghies and life jackets during their first raids under a new law that cracks down on smuggling.

wire.title: Hayden Panettiere's ex Wladimir Klitschko says family in 'profound shock and grief'
wire.summary: The former heavyweight boxing champion shares a child with the Heroes actress, who died on Sunday.

wire.title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
wire.summary: While hailing Zhu’s legacy, authorities are wary that the nostalgia could lead to criticisms of Xi’s rule.
